headline: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals announces $1 billion buyback and executive exit
summary: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals has announced a $1 billion stock repurchase program alongside the departure of a key executive.
why: Alnylam is a biopharmaceutical company. Large capital allocation programs like buybacks are significant for shareholder value, while executive changes can signal shifts in corporate strategy.
